Help.title: Help & Support
Help.earnXpAnswer: Play games, complete missions and unlock achievements while signed in. XP is awarded by our servers, so it may take a moment to show up in your profile.
Help.progressAnswer: XP, streaks, favorites and achievements are only saved to your account while you are signed in.
Help.missionsAnswer: Missions are challenges that refresh on a schedule. Open the Missions tab to see what is active and how much XP each one rewards.
Help.gameLoadQuestion: A game won't load. What can I do?
Help.gameLoadAnswer: Games are provided by third-party publishers and need a stable internet connection. Go back and open the game again, or try another game.
Help.signOutAnswer: Open Account Settings from your profile and tap Sign Out.
